scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "bun run dev:api" "bun run dev:web"
scripts.dev:web: cd apps/web && bun --bun run node_modules/.bin/next dev -p 3000 -H 0.0.0.0
scripts.dev:api: DATABASE_URL=file:$PWD/packages/db/data/custom.db bun run --filter @blasti/db db:push && cd apps/api && bun --hot src/index.ts
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "bun run dev:api" "bun run dev:web"
scripts.build:all: bun run --filter @blasti/web build && bun run --filter @blasti/api build
scripts.build:desktop: bun run build:export && bun run --filter @blasti/desktop build
scripts.build:mobile: bun run build:export && bun run --filter @blasti/mobile cap:sync:android
scripts.electron:dev:full: concurrently -n api,web,desktop -c blue,green,yellow "bun run dev:api" "bun run dev:web" "cd apps/desktop && npx electron . --dev"
